Participants will have 40 seconds to answer each question in Round 3.

Participants must keep their mobile phones and personal belongings inside their bags throughout the event.
Any participant found engaging in malpractice or unfair practices will be immediately disqualified.
The participant or team with the highest score will be declared the winner.

name: 64 SQUARES
subtitle: chess
description: FIDE-timed blitz chess tournament testing deep positional play, tactical vision, and endgame nerve.
rules: Players must register before the tournament starts.
Players must be present at the given match time.
If a player is absent, they will be called once.
A 5-minute waiting time will be given after the scheduled match time.
If the player does not arrive within 5 minutes, they will be disqualified.
Players must follow the standard rules of chess.
Players must not receive help or advice from other players or spectators.
Touching a piece generally means the player must move that piece, if a legal move is possible.
A player must say “Check” only if required by your tournament rules; it is not mandatory under standard chess rules.
Players must respect their opponent and maintain proper discipline.
Any argument or dispute should be reported to the organizer/referee.
The organizer's decision will be followed for tournament-related disputes.

description: Step into the world of strategy, wit, and quick decisions. Bid smart, outthink the rest, and take the win!
rules: A maximum of 12 teams will participate, with each team being randomly assigned an IPL franchise name.
Each team will receive a virtual purse of ₹80 Crore for the entire auction.
Each team must build a minimum squad of 16 players to remain eligible for winner evaluation.
The Playing XI must consist of at least 4 batsmen, 4 bowlers, 1 wicketkeeper, and 2 all-rounders.
A maximum of 4 overseas players is permitted in the Playing XI, with 1 Impact Player allowed.
Exceeding the allocated purse, fake bidding, collusion, or any form of malpractice will result in disqualification.
The winner will be determined based on the performance of the Playing XI according to the announced scoring criteria, along with the applicable evaluation rules.
The decision of the auctioneer and judges will be final and binding in all matters related to the auction.
